quarterly_data.signal: US turnkey award: the US subsidiary T.E.USA won an extra-high-voltage power-grid project in the United States on a turnkey basis - the subsidiary runs local engineering and construction for the whole project, and the Korean head office produces and supplies the main materials (extra-high-voltage cable and accessories) under an about KRW 120 billion materials supply contract signed with the subsidiary and disclosed on the 15th. The total turnkey order value and the ordering customer are not disclosed under a non-disclosure agreement with the customer. The company also states that in January this year it won an about KRW 100 billion extra-high-voltage turnkey project in the US, that it has won all of the 500kV HVAC underground grid projects ordered in the US, and that it secured a 320kV HVDC cable supply contract there. The release links rising US power demand to AI growth and data-center construction, and says the company plans to expand orders for high-value products such as HVDC and submarine cable.
quarterly_data.figure: materials supply contract about KRW 120 billion; US turnkey project won in January this year about KRW 100 billion; all US 500kV HVAC underground projects won
